items.description:
TAH Kenilworth is a well-established small animal veterinary practice, operating for more than 50 years and part of The Animal Hospital and Vetshop group. Its services include vaccinations, consultations, dental care, specialist medicine and veterinary procedures, supported by a surgical unit, a blood bank, a rehabilitation centre and puppy classes.

Alongside the vet practice, the branch runs a Vetshop retail counter for pet supplies, so owners can collect everyday products on the same visit. The practice is at 47 Kenilworth Road in Kenilworth, Cape Town, and the team welcomes pets and their owners by phone, online booking or contact form. The website lists TAH Bellville and TAH Rosmead as its emergency centres, which is useful to know when a pet needs urgent help.

Tawa Massage Therapy is a sports massage practice on Regent Road in Sea Point, run by a therapist with six years of experience who is registered internationally. The treatments focus on sports massage for performance, recovery and rehabilitation, assisted stretching for flexibility and mobility, and dry cupping with therapeutic massage for pain relief, muscle tension and stress.

Each treatment is tailored to the client's specific needs, whether they are an athlete, an active person or someone who simply wants their body to feel and function better. Bookings are made through WhatsApp, and the practice suits anyone looking for hands-on recovery and muscle work close to the city centre.

Tuska Atelier is a Cape Town leather atelier that creates luxury leather goods, with each piece handcrafted locally by skilled artisans. The range uses premium cowhide as well as ostrich and crocodile leather, with an emphasis on timeless design, longevity and understated luxury.

Its flagship store is in The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, at 373-375 Albert Road, where the complete Tuska collection is on show. The store stocks exclusive colours and limited pieces that are not always available online, so visitors can see the work in person before they buy. It is listed among the mill's art and design tenants, and it suits shoppers who want leather goods built to last from a local maker.

Cape Hardware is a hardware store on Voortrekker Road in Goodwood, supplying general hardware, tools, building materials, plumbing and electrical supplies, power tools, paint and water tanks. The business is registered as an essential service provider, and its shelves cover the everyday materials that home and building jobs call for.

The store runs regular specials on lines such as 50kg PPC cement and also stocks pocket bikes and official motorsport caps, so customers can check current prices before they visit. Enquiries can be made by phone or through the contact form on its website, and the store is based at 163 Voortrekker Road, Goodwood, Cape Town.

Checkers at The Point is a full-range supermarket on the ground floor of The Point on Regent Road in Sea Point, in central Cape Town. It carries brand-name and house-label groceries, with fresh produce near the entrance, a bakery and a deli.

Shoppers also find a sushi bar with reasonably priced options and an on-site butcher whose meat section is noted for its quality, and the bakery team is praised for customer service. Visiting outside peak times is a practical tip, since the store can get busy and slow at the tills. It suits city-centre residents and visitors who want a well-stocked grocery shop in Sea Point.

Yemaya Spa & Hair is a hair salon and spa on the second floor of The Point in Sea Point, offering spa, beauty and hair treatments. The beauty menu blends traditional and modern techniques, and the team uses professional products from brands including Babor, Environ, Footlogix, Guinot, Heliocare, Instantly Ageless, Kerastase and Nioxin.

Bookings for spa, beauty and hair treatments are taken through the salon's website, and gift vouchers are available for anyone who wants to give a treatment as a present. The salon describes its aim as a unique journey created for each guest, in the heart of Cape Town, making it a good fit for anyone looking for a restorative escape close to the city centre.

items.description:
The Factory Shop in Montague Gardens is a discount food outlet supplied directly by a range of food manufacturers, built around a focused grocery and pantry range rather than general household goods. Its stock centres on nuts, dried fruit, tinned goods and baking ingredients, making it a destination for home bakers and cooks who buy these items in bulk rather than at standard supermarket prices.

Because it buys straight from manufacturers, the outlet can offer factory pricing on these staple pantry lines, a different model from an ordinary small grocery store. It suits households stocking up on baking supplies, dried goods and tinned food, as well as anyone looking to save on everyday pantry items bought in larger quantities.

The shop trades from Montague Drive in Montague Gardens, Cape Town, next to Brito's, open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 4:30pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, closed Sundays and public holidays.

items.description:
Timbercity Montague Gardens supplies timber and wood materials for building and renovation projects, backed by more than 40 years of experience as one of South Africa's established timber suppliers. Alongside standard timber and board ranges, the branch offers board cutting, drilling and edging services, so customers can leave with material already prepared for their project instead of cutting it themselves.

The branch also delivers orders to a customer's home or building site, which suits both DIY enthusiasts tackling a weekend project and professional builders sourcing material for a larger job. Its combination of stock, in-house cutting services and delivery is aimed at making it easier to get a building project started without unnecessary hassle.

The branch trades from 1 Marconi Road in Montague Gardens, Cape Town, serving the greater Cape Town area with timber and building-material supplies.

items.description:
Woolworths Food at Okavango Crossing in Kraaifontein is a dedicated food and grocery store carrying Woolworths' range of fresh produce, ready meals and everyday groceries. Shoppers describe the branch as a large, well-stocked store with wide aisles and a clean shopping environment, and several note the staff as consistently friendly and helpful.

As a food-focused branch rather than a full department store, it concentrates on grocery and food essentials for the surrounding Kraaifontein community, trading alongside other retailers at the Okavango Crossing centre. It suits local households doing a regular grocery shop as well as shoppers picking up Woolworths-brand ready meals and fresh produce.

The store is at Okavango Crossing, on the corner of Okavango and Langeberg Roads in Kraaifontein, trading Monday from 09:00 to 18:00, Tuesday to Saturday from 09:00 to 19:00, and Sunday from 09:00 to 18:00.

items.description:
Zone Fitness Kraaifontein is one of the Zone Fitness group's clubs across Cape Town, with sister branches including Bellville, Milnerton, Parow, Rondebosch, Fish Hoek, Muizenberg, Tokai and Table View. The Kraaifontein club opened its doors to members on 1 May 2016, bringing the chain's training format to Brighton Square Shopping Centre on the corner of Brighton and Kipling Road.

The gym is set up with a dedicated cardio section, a full weights section for strength training, and an aerobic studio used for the club's group fitness classes. Membership consultants work from the Brighton Square club to help new members sign up and choose a plan that suits them. It is a straightforward option for Kraaifontein residents who want cardio equipment, weight training and scheduled classes together under one roof.

items.description:
Aneesa's Take-Aways is a long-standing takeaway restaurant in Wynberg that has been serving the local area since 1976. Its menu is built around classic Cape Town takeaway fare, including gatsbys, chip parcels, burgers, sandwiches, platters, hot chips, hotdogs and chips, salomies, curry and rice, and a breakfast menu, with regular specials offered alongside the standard range.

The takeaway is especially known for its Vienna-and-chips parcels, a signature order that has helped build its reputation with regulars over the decades. It serves local residents, workers and visitors looking for a quick, affordable meal rather than a sit-down dining experience. Aneesa's Take-Aways trades from 86 Ottery Road in Wynberg, Cape Town.

items.description:
Checkers at Constantia Emporium is a flagship-format Checkers store that opened its doors in 2019, bringing a more upmarket grocery offering to the Constantia area. At 2,330 square metres, the store was built as one of the chain's larger-format outlets, with a stronger focus on fresh and specialty departments than a standard Checkers branch.

The Constantia Emporium store includes freshly made artisanal breads and pastries, luxury cakes, and a coffee bar built around an artisanal roaster, along with a wine-tasting room for customers to try wines while they shop. It gives Constantia-area households and shoppers a full grocery range alongside these speciality food and drink sections. The store trades from 55 Ladies Mile Road, Constantia, Cape Town.

items.description:
Checkers Hyper is a large-format supermarket trading from the Helderberg Centre in Somerset West, listed in the centre's own store directory among its food and grocery tenants, alongside its own in-centre Checkers Liquor Shop. As a Hyper-format branch, it carries the chain's full grocery, fresh produce and household range for shoppers across the area.

The store shares the centre with a wide mix of health, beauty, fashion and home tenants, including Clicks, Pick n Pay Clothing, Spec Savers and Pep Home, making it part of a wider shopping destination for Somerset West and the surrounding Helderberg area. It is a convenient option for households doing a full grocery shop alongside other errands in one visit.

Circle Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy trading as part of the WeCare Pharmacy Network, a group of independently owned pharmacies that share buying power and support while remaining locally run. The pharmacy offers everyday dispensing and healthcare services alongside general wellness and over-the-counter products for its Somerset West community.

Being part of the WeCare network gives the pharmacy access to group-level pricing and support while keeping day-to-day decisions with the local team on site. Circle Pharmacy trades from Shop 22-25, Circle Centre, Main Road, in Somerset West, and serves local patients and shoppers looking for a nearby pharmacy for prescriptions, chronic medication and everyday health needs.
